file_purpose: Evidence record for HYMS A100 official eligibility, official selection-framework structure, explicitly unofficial estimate mode, applicant-pool handling, result-card disclosure and production readiness.

research_scope.primary_course: Hull York Medical School MB BS Medicine A100
research_scope.primary_scope: Official eligibility and selection-framework rules, plus a separately identified third-party estimate mode.
excluded_related_courses: A108 Medicine with a Gateway Year
research_scope.notes: The estimate input was supplied in the authoritative research handoff and is not treated as official HYMS evidence.

evidence_classification_policy.official: HYMS, UCAS and UCAT material supports eligibility rules, component maxima, numerical ranking and contextual scope.
evidence_classification_policy.historical_guidance: Official HYMS 2025 application, interview and offer totals are context only. Pool-specific cut-offs are not officially published.
evidence_classification_policy.research_derived: National UCAT decile lookup is derived from the shared official UCAT dataset.
evidence_classification_policy.unofficial_estimate: Exact component tariffs and recommendation bands come from an unverified third-party model and must carry the mandatory disclosure.
evidence_classification_policy.unknown: Missing official tariffs, tie-breakers and pool-specific cut-offs are recorded as evidence gaps.
evidence_classification_policy.intake_caveat: The third-party contextual automatic-maximum rule conflicts with HYMS's official minimum-two-criteria rule. Official contextual eligibility is therefore reported separately.

metadata.selection_model_mapping: Dedicated consumer using the Nottingham adapter precedent

route_limited_blockers: Unverified international qualification equivalences require manual review.
Graduate and prior-university applicants receive a score breakdown but no numerical recommendation band because route-specific historical guidance is unavailable.
readiness.summary: Ready for scoped production use: official eligibility is executable for supported routes and HYMS-specific numerical guidance is visibly labelled as an unofficial, low-confidence estimate.

course_identity.university: University of Hull and University of York
related_routes: A108 Medicine with a Gateway Year

gcse.minimum: Six GCSEs at grade 4/C or above, including English Language and Mathematics at grade 6/B or above.
gcse.selection_role: Best six grades contribute up to 35 official framework points.

a_level.minimum: AAA including Biology and Chemistry, studied and awarded concurrently in one sitting.
a_level.practical_endorsement: Not stated as a separate requirement in the supplied official research; not inferred.

international_baccalaureate.minimum: 36 overall with Higher Level 6,6,5 and grade 6 in Biology and Chemistry.

standard_routes: AAAAB at Higher plus BBB at Advanced Higher including Biology and Chemistry.
AAAAA at Higher plus AA at Advanced Higher in Biology and Chemistry.

graduate.minimum: Degree at 2:1 plus three distinct A levels at BBB in the first sitting.

international.ielts: 7.5 overall with at least 7.0 in every component, within two years.
international.equivalence: Country-specific rules are extensive; only applicant evidence verified by HYMS is automatically accepted outside A-level and IB routes.

special_policies.minimum_age: 18 on 1 October in the enrolment year.

official_selection_framework.ranking_method: Eligible applicants are ranked in numerical order.

official_criteria: School below national-average Progress 8 or devolved-nation equivalent
excluded_groups: Applicants who previously started or completed a university course
effects: Fast-track consideration at the applicable UCAT decile
Potential reduced or alternative offer conditions

international.guidance: Only a rough UCAT directional divide is available; the approximately 11-place cohort makes fixed score bands unreliable.

estimate_mode.mandatory_disclosure: This is an estimate based on unofficial, third-party scoring assumptions — Hull York Medical School has not published its exact points formula and has formally declined to release it under a Freedom of Information request. Treat this score as directional, not exact.

evidence_gaps: Current and historical selection-score cut-offs by applicant group.
Home, International, Contextual and Graduate application-funnel breakdowns.

Detailed fitness-to-practise, DBS and occupational-health rules.

source_register.use: Academic, resit, age and transfer eligibility
Estimate-mode tariffs and recommendation bands only

do_not_infer: Do not call the estimate an official or confirmed HYMS score.
Do not merge official eligibility with unofficial point tariffs.
Do not apply contextual estimate points to international, graduate or prior-university applicants.
Do not present estimate bands as current cut-offs, probabilities or guarantees.
Do not infer unverified international equivalence.
